name: ALPS Alpine EC11 rotary encoder
summary: The ubiquitous 11 mm EC11 incremental rotary encoder. This PCB-mount version needs a 7 mm panel clearance hole for its 6 mm D-shaft.
source: ALPS Alpine EC11 series catalogue, drawing No.2: 11.7 mm body width, 9.2 mm body depth and 6 mm D-shaft. EC11 is a family: shaft length, presence of push switch, and the five-hole PCB pattern vary by suffix. The 7.0 mm panel hole is a practical clearance for the 6.0 mm shaft, not an ALPS panel-cutout specification.
